messages:
jamie_support: forwarding from Acme - after last night's rollout their integration to our tool endpoint /tools/billing started failing with 422 schema_validation_failed. they say payload format hasn't changed on their side. stack: webhook -> our API -> model -> tool. they included logs (pasting below). :frowning:

maya_eng: thanks. can you paste the exact request/response and the model version that handled the call?

jamie_support: here are the snippets from their app and our response:
```
POST /v1/call_tool HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
{
  "tool": "charge_customer",
  "args": {
    "customer_id": "acme-123",
    "amount": 100
    // NOTE: currency field is NOT present - they never needed it before
  }
}
Response 422:
{
  "error": "schema_validation_failed",
  "details": "missing required field 'currency' for tool billing_v2.schema.v2"
}
Model: rwd-infer-2026-2.3.1 (canary)
Trace: trace-id=trc_0a9f1e
```

liam_sre: I pulled the same trace. runtime saw the model emit a tool_call selection 'billing_v2' with args that don't match the declared schema. raw model output (trimmed):
```
{"tool":"billing_v2","args":"amount=100;customer=acme-123"}
```
so the model serialized args as a single string (legacy behavior expected a JSON object). that string then fails schema validation in tool invocation.

deploy-bot: canary deploy rwd-infer-2026-2.3.1 -> us-east-1 at 2026-03-16T22:14Z (by CI).

maya_eng: this explains it — the new model variant returns a flattened args string for some tools. previous model used a JSON object; our tool-routing layer expects typed args. two questions: how many customers hit billing tools on canary? and do we rollback or route affected customers to older model?

jamie_support: Acme is a large customer (enterprise). they are asking for immediate rollback or pinning. Customer Success (kate) is asking for credits if we don't fix quickly.

customer_success_kate: Acme is impacted in production; ops said they can do per-customer routing. customer expects a fix in <24h. recommending we pin them and offer credits until fixed. :warning:

ops_lead: we can create a routing rule to pin acme-123 API tokens to rwd-infer-2026-2.3.0 in ~25 min. ETA 25m. however that doesn't fix other customers on canary.

liam_sre: scope: we see ~3% of production calls hit canary. only customers routed to canary (mostly new signups and a few enterprise test traffic) are affected. global rollback not required yet, but we should be cautious.

maya_eng: proposed plan - (1) route Acme to 2.3.0 immediately (ops), (2) push runtime hotfix to accept stringified args by attempting parse; record a metric when parsing occurs (eng), (3) add canary validation that tests tool-calling for billing tools with strict schema before rollout (eng + devex). does that sound ok?

jamie_support: Acme confirmed pinning is acceptable short-term if ETA is quick.

liam_sre: on the runtime fix: I can add a shim that if args is a string, try parse of the form 'k1=v1;k2=v2' and convert to JSON object. will make tolerant for now and log counts. ETA 90m for patch + 30m deploy.

maya_eng: also need to log the model emitted tool string so model team can add behavioral regression test. I'll open an incident ticket and assign to inference-research.

support-bot: incident created INC-2026-173: "model-tool-arg-shape-regression after rwd-infer-2026-2.3.1 canary" assigned to inference-research, severity: P2.

customer_success_kate: communicating to Acme - telling them we will pin them and follow up in 1h with ETA.

ops_lead: pin rule applied for api_key acme-123 -> rwd-infer-2026-2.3.0. confirm from logs in ~5m.

liam_sre: runtime shim rolled out to canary and prod routing in staging pipeline. initial telemetry shows ~12 hits where args were string; shim converted them and tool call succeeded. logging metrics: tool_arg_shape_mismatch=12 (last 10m).

maya_eng: good. next steps: inference team to audit model generation for tool-calls (why did it switch to string serialization), runtime to keep tolerant parsing for 48h, devex to add a pre-rollout harness that validates tool_call shapes against the tool schema. will leave global rollback off for now unless we see >1% error spike or SLA breach.

jamie_support: Acme thanked us for quick action and will monitor. booking follow-up with customer success in 2h. :thumbsup:

maya_eng: created follow-up PRs: runtime-shim (#4123), canary-tests (#4124), model-audit ticket (RDW-1178). assigning model-audit to @inference-research.

liam_sre: logging note: include trace-id in customer comms if they report more instances (trc_0a9f1e etc).

jamie_support: closing thread for now - will reopen if Acme sees more failures. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
